title: Improve the conflict report when a package from pylock.toml conflicts with other requirements
author: sbidoul
body_preview: For now such an error looks like this: `ERROR: Locked version 3.13 for package 'idna' from 'pylock.1.toml' is not compatible with other requirements for the same package (<3,==3.13)`. In the last part, `==3.13` is superfluous because it is the specifier from the lock file itself, and `<3` should be accompanied with the indication of the origin of that specifier.
